hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains in the intensive care unit at DF Star Hospital in Brasília following acute intestinal obstruction complicated by bilateral aspiration pneumonia. The medical crisis has amplified internal friction within the Bolsonaro family, while Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized the temporary removal of his ankle monitor during his hospital stay.
hotspots.affect: The health emergency mobilizes intense emotional concern, conspiracy theories, and partisan grievance across Bolsonarista media networks.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Heading into the final stretch before Spain's November 29 snap elections, Santiago Abascal and Vox leaders are escalating warnings of election fraud, attacking Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez over Catalan amnesty laws, and urging right-wing voters to oust the left. Vox faces sharp opposition over its anti-immigrant platform while navigating contentious coalition dynamics with the mainstream People's Party (PP).
hotspots.affect: Election proximity and aggressive rhetoric surrounding vote integrity create an atmosphere of urgent systemic confrontation.

hotspots.title: AfD Escalates Deportation Demands at Party Congresses
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) dominates German political coverage as party figures including Alice Weidel, Björn Höcke, and Maximilian Krah clash internally over the scope of their radical 'remigration' and mass deportation proposals. Opponents intensify calls for a constitutional ban on the party, while CDU leaders label AfD hardliners as foreign collaborators.
hotspots.affect: High moral panic and systemic alarm surround the party's radical anti-immigration platform and potential ban proceedings.

hotspots.title: RN Headquarters Raided in State Leaks Probe
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National party leader Jordan Bardella has publicly denounced ongoing investigations into confidential state leaks to the party, claiming the judicial timing is a targeted attempt to harm the RN. Prefect Hugues Moutouh has announced legal actions over the controversy while Marine Le Pen defends the party against charges of improperly receiving intelligence.
hotspots.affect: Charged with anti-establishment defiance, RN framing portrays legal inquiries as deep-state interference in democratic processes.

hotspots.title: Milei Battles Internal Feuds over PASO Primary Suspension
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei is pushing to suspend the PASO primary elections while contending with legislative pushback on electoral reforms and the 2027 budget. Internal coalition instability is growing as allied deputies defect from the bloc and presidential sister Karina Milei aggressively reorganizes youth wings to consolidate executive authority.
hotspots.affect: Factional infighting and legislative vulnerability generate continuous tension within the libertarian movement.
